generated.details: On the mid-plane left tabletop, the plain unlabelled document storage box has a closed fitted lid over rigid oatmeal-colored board walls and a flat base.
Beside the box, slightly nearer the edge, folded reading glasses have two clear lenses joined by a bridge and hinged temples folded behind them.
On the far-plane upper-left wall, abstract framed artwork comprises a cream-and-charcoal nonfigurative print within a slim oak frame and recessed mat.
